stock.description: Horizon Construction Development Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, delivering equipment operation solutions throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's offerings include rental services for a diverse range of machinery, such as aerial work platforms, modern excavation support systems, and advanced formwork systems. Additionally, it provides specialized engineering and technical assistance, along with platforms and other services, including the sale of equipment, components, and materials. Founded in 2011 and based in Tianjin, China, the company operates as a subsidiary of Far East Horizon Limited.
